title: 高中英文學測挑戰單字

vocabulary.example: After a scandal, the king was forced to abdicate.
vocabulary.example_translation: 在丑闻之后，国王被迫让出皇位。

vocabulary.example: The car needs to accelerate quickly to catch up with the traffic.
vocabulary.example_translation: 车需要迅速加速以赶上交通。

vocabulary.example: I didn't know him, so I asked my friend to acquaint us.
vocabulary.example_translation: 我不認識他，所以我問我的朋友介紹一下。

vocabulary.example: She is ambitious and wants to be a successful businesswoman.
vocabulary.example_translation: (她是個有抱負、渴望成功的女性)

vocabulary.example: There is animosity between the two countries after the war.
vocabulary.example_translation: 戰爭之後，這兩個國家間產生了仇恨

vocabulary.example: I'm apprehensive about the exam next week.
vocabulary.example_translation: 我對下週的考試感到惶恐。

vocabulary.example: The critics assailed the movie for its poor acting.
vocabulary.example_translation: 評論家對电影的演技下了狠手

vocabulary.example: She is an assiduous student and always attends classes on time.
vocabulary.example_translation: 她很勤奮，總是准時參加課堂

vocabulary.example: The company's audacious plan to expand globally was successful.
vocabulary.example_translation: 這家公司的全球擴張藍圖很成功

vocabulary.example: The doctor's callous attitude towards his patients made them suffer.
vocabulary.example_translation: 醫生對他的病人態度冷酷，讓他們受苦

vocabulary.example: The magician captivated the audience with his magic tricks.
vocabulary.example_translation: 魔術師用他的魔術手法迷住了觀眾

vocabulary.example: She was complacent with her grade and didn't try to improve.
There is dissension in the team about the strategy.
vocabulary.example_translation: 這個團隊有關策略的分歧

vocabulary.example: The company promotes an egalitarian work environment.
vocabulary.example_translation: 公司是平等主義的，所有員工待遇一樣

vocabulary.example: The artist's enigmatic smile is a mystery to everyone.
vocabulary.example_translation: 藝術家的笑容很難解釋
